purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Tiruppur has an official land-records service and urban TSLR/FMB extract workflow. The published entry route is record-keyed (town/block/ward/survey/subdivision); it exposes no anonymous coordinate-to-parcel lookup or vector geometry schema. No record-specific identifier was submitted, so no private record was requested and no polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: District-specific Survey & Land Records office and official land record routes confirmed. Public parcel-vector coverage at the WUP point is unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Tiruppur District Administration lists official land e-services (Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-register, patta and poramboke verification) and identifies its Assistant Director, Survey & Land Records.
National Government Services Portal describes the Tamil Nadu land-record service input hierarchy: district plus urban/rural, then town/block/ward/survey/subdivision for urban records.
Official Tamil Nadu e-Services entry point linked from the Tiruppur District Administration page; its service page did not resolve through the anonymous page reader during this review.
